build_apptool_from_function: build an AppTool from a decorated function using build_tool to extract signature and docstring metadata
create_apptool_decorator: create a tool decorator with app_tool to register a function as an app tool for LLM agents
convert_to_openai_format: convert an AppTool to OpenAI function calling format using the to_open_ai method
adapt_python_types: adapt Python type names to JSON schema types using adapt_type for int and float conversion
parse_docstring_examples: parse function call examples from docstrings using parse_function_call_example to extract argument mappings
